title: Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Brick Officers' Quarters, Types E & F, Area A, Dayton, Montgomery County, OH
notes: Significance: The majority of quarters within the Brick Officers' Quarters complex are doubles, represented by plan types "C," "D," "E" and "F."  Together the doubles represent 23 structures which comprise 46 of the total 91 quarters; 17 of these are the "E" and "F" types intended for Field Officers.  With the same floor plan, "E" and "F" vary only slightly in size and in exterior detail.  The principal differences are in the roof types and in window, doorway and porch treatments.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 100003071
